adds.title: Executive Order of January 20, 2025 - Trump gender recognition order
adds.summary: On January 20, 2025 the executive order Defending Women From Gender Ideology Extremism And Restoring Biological Truth To The Federal Government establishes that the U.S. federal government recognizes only two immutable sexes, male and female as determined at conception/birth, and directs federal agencies to enforce sex-based distinctions on that basis, requiring federal IDs including passports and visas to reflect birth sex rather than gender identity, mandating single-sex federal facilities and housing of federal prisoners by birth sex, and prohibiting federal funding and promotion of gender-identity policies.
